Yes, you likely qualify. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any benefits. Since your renewal was yesterday and you haven't used it, you're well within the window.

The policy excerpts I have don't spell out the exact cancellation steps, so I can't tell you which button to press. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to process the cancellation and refund if you'd like. Just keep in mind that if you use any Plus benefit (like free shipping or member pricing) before cancelling, you'd lose refund eligibility.
